spans.text: Here's a reminder: all the Sangvis Dolls you have encountered so far...were dummies that I set up.
They have neither sentience nor consciousness, and naturally...require no complex reconstruction.
So come, be my guest...and torment these pitiful creatures to your heart's content!
M4A1, Ouroboros has reanimated the dummies of Hunter, Executioner and Architect.
Their stats may not be higher than their previous versions, but that doesn't make them any less dangerous. Please take care.
Understood. I have started formulating an infiltration plan.
By the way, M4A1, this is the passcode to the door of the control room.
Actually...we didn't tell you before because M16A1 asked us not to...
She thought this control room was your only protection.
She was afraid that you'd be in danger if you left.
That's what she's always been doing...
She was trying to substitute herself with the control room...to protect me...
But she forgot...that no one could ever replace her...
And some day, I'll have to survive on my own...
